# skycloak_password_blacklist_file (Resource)

Uploads a password blacklist file to a dedicated cluster, for Keycloak's `passwordBlacklist(<name>)` realm password policy. Files cannot be changed after upload: new content needs a new `name`, and changing the name replaces the file. The first file on a cluster adds a small persistent folder to the Keycloak pods, which takes a restart: it waits for the cluster's maintenance window unless `apply_now` is set. A cluster holds at most 10 files of up to 25 MB each. Once the file is `ready`, set the realm password policy to use it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Upload a list of passwords to refuse, one per line (up to 25 MB, 10 files per
# cluster). The cluster must be dedicated.
resource "skycloak_password_blacklist_file" "common" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  name       = "common-passwords-2026"
  source     = "${path.module}/blacklists/common-passwords.txt"

  # The first file on a cluster adds a small persistent folder to the Keycloak
  # pods, which takes a restart. By default it waits for the cluster's
  # maintenance window. Set apply_now to restart at once and wait until the
  # file is ready.
  apply_now = true

  # Files cannot be changed after upload: new content needs a new name. A realm
  # password policy that names the old file blocks its deletion, so create the
  # new file first, move the policy to it, then remove the old one.
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# Once the file is ready, set the realm password policy
# passwordBlacklist(common-passwords-2026) on each realm that should use it.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `name` (String) Name of the file on the cluster: letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore only, up to 255 characters, and unique on the cluster. A change replaces the file, which the API refuses while a realm password policy names the old file; create the new file first with `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` and move the policy in between.
- `source` (String) Path to the file to upload, one password per line, up to 25 MB.

### Optional

- `apply_now` (Boolean) Restart the cluster at once to add the blacklist folder instead of waiting for the maintenance window, and wait for the file to be `ready`. Defaults to `false`. It only matters for the first file on a cluster, or while an earlier file is still waiting for the restart. It is not stored by the API, so it reads as `false` after an import.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the file. Recomputed each plan; a change to the file's content under an unchanged `name` is refused.
- `id` (String) File name, as used in `passwordBlacklist(<name>)`.
- `size` (Number) Size of the file in bytes.
- `status` (String) Delivery status (`waiting_for_restart`, `delivering`, `ready`, `failed`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import skycloak_password_blacklist_file.common 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/common-passwords-2026
```
